blocks.html: Robinsons Malls celebrates love in all forms with “Love Happens,” a series of Valentine exclusive events, promotions, and activities specially prepared for its valued shoppers and diners this February.

“The Valentine season is a very important occasion for us and we want all our customers to create special memories and fun moments together in our malls. This year, we prepared to treat them to more exciting events and delightful offers to make their shopping, dining, and leisure experiences more memorable,” says Arlene Magtibay, SVP and General Manager of Robinsons Malls

V-Day Attractions are set to delight mall-goers with a variety of seasonal installations and pop-ups so they can capture priceless moments together. Couples, barkadas, and families alike can take their photos and have them printed at the pop-up booths in Robinsons Galleria and Robinsons Magnolia. Couples can seal their love for each other through the Love Locks corner at Robinsons Metro East. For those with preference for more adventure-filled celebration, they can go karting and driftito in Pair Rides at Galleria South and East Deck Lifestyle Hub. Furparents can also have a lot of fun taking snaps of their furbabies at the different Insta-worthy themed decors at various malls nationwide. And they get the chance to win a prize too if they post their photos and join thr Picure Paw-fect Promo.

Mass wedding events have been set at Robinsons Place GenSan, Robinsons Place Valencia, Robinsons Place Pavia, and Robinsons Novaliches for all the #couplegoals who have yet to tie the knot! Truly, #LoveHappensAtRobinsonsMalls.

Even kids have special treats waiting for them this Heart’s Day, with “Cupid’s Drive-Thru Treats” happening at Iloilo malls. And if you thought pediatric vaccination can’t possibly be any fun, Robinsons has gone the extra mile to prepare various Valentine’s-themed programs for kids in several malls.

Hugots and declarations of love are sure to fill the air, too, with Rhythms of the Heart that are set to serenade shoppers with acoustic band performances, classic piano renditions, spoken word poetry, and a special performance by the QC Symphonic Band. Date Deals also abound for diners at various Robinsons Malls locations: from special bundles to discounts, bouquet arrangements, and heart balloons, mealtime is sure to get sweeter any time of day.

And whether you choose to celebrate Valentine’s solo or with family or friends, you’re sure to get the best deals at Robinson’s Lovely Finds promo, during which a vast array of merchants will offer deals and discounts to Robinsons Malls shoppers.
For those who choose to celebrate at home – personal shoppers Robbie & Rosie offer special Valentine’s treats including waived shopping fee and a surprise gift for a minimum purchase.

So go ahead and plan that shopping trip! However you plan to celebrate love, whether it’s with a special someone, with family, or by just treating yourself to a nice pair of shoes, your favorite mall has got you covered.

The sweet deals get even sweeter with RMalls+ App, the mall’s newly-launched mobile app. For the whole month of February, Robinsons Malls shares the love with valued shoppers through app-exclusive vouchers, freebies from partner restaurants and shops, and first dibs on special offers, all redeemable via the RMalls+ app. Shoppers get to also enjoy VIP experiences this love month with FREE parking, access to the VIP Pay Lounge, free PlayLab passes and a lot more. To download the app and claim your exclusive vouchers, click here or visit http://onelink.to/rmallsplusapp.
